title: Hebrew Igrot Kodesh: direct letter body and public search-extract review
review_method: Public web search/open; item-level public Hebrew letter pages and visible search-result body extracts. No runner-side crawler.
source_body_inspection_method: Three public item pages were directly opened with readable Hebrew body text (AID 5054491 existing identity, AID 5100372 new item, and AID 5357409 existing duplicate presentation); eight additional public search-result body extracts were inspected. Four search extracts (AIDs 5100353, 5100285, 5071046 and 5019408) matched existing Verified propositions and were rechecked in place without duplicate propositions. AID 4666220 was opened and redirected to a Torah Texts summary/navigation shell; same-run fallback used other accessible Hebrew Igrot Kodesh pages.

fallback_source_results.source: Chabad.org/TheRebbe.org — Hebrew Igrot Kodesh item pages
fallback_source_results.result: Five genuinely new Hebrew source families were added; four other AIDs were already represented by Verified canonical records and were rechecked in place. AID 5054491 was enriched in place. AID 5357409 was linked to the fuller AID 4872269 presentation as the same Evidence Family.

blocked_candidates.reason: Public web open redirected to https://www.chabad.org/torah-texts/4666220/page/default.htm, a navigation/summary shell with no readable item-level letter body.
blocked_candidates.handling: Excluded from content promotion; no crawler retry or access-control bypass. Nine other Hebrew Igrot Kodesh pages were inspected in the same run as fallback.

not_promoted_after_inspection.reason: The publisher's own note states that this partial presentation was later published more fully as volume 18, letter ג׳קפב, dated 11 Tevet; the full presentation is AID 4872269. The two pages are the same correspondence, not independent witnesses.
not_promoted_after_inspection.handling: Do not create a new Evidence Family or count a second witness. Record a same_evidence_family alias relation to AID 4872269 and audit the canonical identity before applying the family ID.

duplicate_aliases_linked.basis: The AID 5357409 publisher note explicitly cross-references the fuller publication as AID 4872269, volume 18 letter ג׳קפב, dated 11 Tevet 5715. The existing AID 5357409 item is now assigned the shared Evidence Family and marked non-independent; AID 4872269 itself is not ingested as a second item.

existing_identity_updates.new_proposition_locator: Chabad.org/TheRebbe.org AID 5054491, body line 298, directly reopened on 2026-11-15.

deduplication_check.note: The reconciliation audit found four AIDs already represented by canonical Verified records; their search-extract content was already covered, so no duplicate propositions or source identities were added. AID 5357409 was already canonical and is now assigned the same Evidence Family as the publisher-identified fuller AID 4872269, without creating a second item. AID 4872269 is not currently ingested.

limitations: Four new AIDs were not promoted as new records because reconciliation found existing canonical Verified identities; the reviewed extracts already matched their propositions, so the existing records were rechecked in place without duplicate propositions.
Four genuinely new identities rely only on visible public search-result body extracts because direct item opens redirected to a summary/navigation shell; they remain Parsed and partial-context.

AID 5100372 is the only new record promoted to Verified because its item-level Hebrew body was directly opened; this verifies only the published text, not an autograph, incoming letter or full archival context.
AID 5054491 is an existing Verified identity enriched in place with one additional bounded proposition; its Evidence Family is unchanged.
AID 5071046 remains a secretariat cover letter reproducing a telegram explicitly attributed by the publisher to the Rebbe; the cover letter itself is not attributed to the Rebbe.
AID 5357409 is an existing partial presentation of AID 4872269 and is now non-independent within the shared Evidence Family; AID 4872269 itself is not ingested.
AID 4666220 redirected to a navigation shell and was excluded; same-run fallback was used.
No original manuscripts, incoming letters, secretariat originals, scans, or full archival contexts were inspected; no full copyrighted text was copied and no AI inference was attributed to the Rebbe.

records.title: אגרות קודש — מכתב ו׳תתנז
response_propositions: המענה משיב לשואל שתיאר קושי בהתקדמות בענייני תורה ומצוות והשווה את מצבו לבחורים שאורח חייהם נראה קל יותר; התשובה משתמשת בהכשרה מקצועית כדוגמה לכך שהישג מעשי דורש שנות לימוד והכנה, ולא רק רצון לבצע.
